title: Brand new to AI trading, wondering if this setup is overcomplicated.
author: DriveAdventurous1403
selftext:
I’m brand new to AI trading, so I’ve been using ChatGPT and Claude to help plan a crypto trading bot setup. It suggested building around Freqtrade, FreqAI and Kraken/Kraken Futures as the wallets, so I’ve been doing that for a bit, but no successes at all.  
For people who actually know what they’re doing, is this setup way too complicated, or is this a normal way to approach building a trading bot? Is there a simpler or better setup I should be looking at instead?
